text: Lazy-river rules require the supplied tubes, entry and exit at the tube area, and waiting for the lifeguard’s instruction. Parents with young children may share a tube; otherwise only one rider is permitted. The rules do not establish transfer equipment or staff transfer help.
quote: Enter and exit from tube area only.
Must wait for instruction from lifeguard before starting.
Riders must use tubes provided. Two sizes are available
Parents with young children may ride in tubes together. Otherwise only one rider per tube; no doubles, trains or chains.
history_note: Added the parent/young-child shared-tube exception while preserving the absence of transfer equipment/help evidence.
